programme.title: Around the world with David Attenborough – Our planet | E02
programme.desc: When Sir David Attenborough, the British writer, traveler and popularizer of nature knowledge, turned 80, many thought it was the end of his career. However, it turns out that it was quite the opposite. Attenborough made a series of nature films examining the development of life on Earth, from its origins at the bottom of the ocean to the present day. He presents the results of his research in a series of documentary films... Great Britain. 2020. documentary series

programme.title: Survive the asteroid | E01
programme.desc: More than 66 billion years ago, a giant asteroid hit our planet and thus ended the age of dinosaurs. Researchers are wondering why animals that weighed more than 500 grams were unable to survive. Experts will consider what we know about the species that survived this collision... France, Great Britain. 2023. documentary series

programme.title: Birth of birds | E02
programme.desc: The entire history of birds goes back over 220 million years. Experts will look at the latest fossils of a modern bird. They will try to find out how and why these animals were able to survive the impact of an asteroid on our planet... Great Britain. 2024. documentary series

programme.title: The Wild East of Poland
programme.desc: The documentary focuses on one of the last wild regions in Europe, the Biebrza Valley. The largest National Park in Poland is a habitat for beavers, otters and a whole host of water birds... Germany, Poland. 2023. documentary film

programme.title: Earth seen from space – Patterns and patterns | S01E02
programme.desc: A documentary series showing phenomena on Earth recorded by cameras in space. Will be shown, among others: great animal migrations, changes of seasons, sea tides and breathtaking neon lights of the northern lights. When the Earth is viewed from space, its surface is covered with multicolored spots and shapes. Modern technology and a completely new perspective will allow you to look at, among others, elephants in the Congo and wombats burrowing in the Australian wilderness. USA, Great Britain. 2019. documentary series

programme.title: Earth seen from space – Colorful planet | S01E03
programme.desc: A documentary series showing phenomena on Earth recorded by cameras in space. Will be shown, among others: great animal migrations, changes of seasons, sea tides and breathtaking neon lights of the northern lights. Our planet is stunning from space. It shimmers with various colors, e.g. China has a beautiful yellow color coming from rapeseed flowers. The neon lights of the northern lights please the eye with their blue. USA, Great Britain. 2019. documentary series

programme.title: Year on Earth – Spring | E02
programme.desc: The authors observe changes in ecosystems in various places on the Earth's surface. The rhythm of these changes is determined by the movement of the Blue Planet around the Sun. In March, the northern hemisphere begins to be better illuminated. The air temperature is rising, the snow is melting, and nature is awakening to new life. Great Britain. 2022. documentary series

programme.title: Common planet – Open spaces | E02

programme.title: 30 for 30: Elway to Marino
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: SEC Now: NFL Draft Special
programme.desc: SEC Now (Sports). The flagship news and information program of the SEC Network – ESPN's 24/7 multiplatform sports network devoted to the Southeastern Conference – is «SEC Now,» broadcast weekdays from the network's studios in Charlotte, N.C. Hosted by Dari Nowkhah, Peter Burns or Alyssa Lang, the show includes a mix of sports coverage, in-depth features, insider access, and exclusive interviews with the movers and shakers of the conference's 14 teams

programme.title: The Last Dance: Episode 5
programme.desc: The Last Dance (Sports). In the fall of 1997, Michael Jordan and the Chicago Bulls allowed a film crew to follow them as they went for their sixth NBA title in eight seasons. That resulted in a stunning portrait of one of the sport's most iconic athletes and a celebrated team. «The Last Dance» follows the Bulls' 1997-98 season from start to finish, while also covering the rest of the chapters in Jordan's remarkable career. The 10-part docuseries follows the Jordan timeline from when he was an emerging star on his high school team to becoming a worldwide marketing force and cultural figure. The series takes its name from a phrase coined by then-Bulls coach Phil Jackson, who knew that the season would likely be the final run for the core members of that 1990s Bulls dynasty

programme.title: d/s Lost Treasures of Egypt. Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: Along the western border of the Valley of the Kings lies one of the last remaining unexcavated burial sites. This season, American Egyptologist Don Ryan works tirelessly to conduct a forensic examination of the contents of Tomb 49, hoping to find treasures left behind by ancient robbers. His team makes an incredible discovery - a ring from one of the great Egyptian pharaohs - Ramses III, which is 3000 years old. This forced Don to change the course of his research and lifted the veil of secrecy over the amazing history of state-sanctioned burial plunder on an industrial basis. Not far from the Valley of the Kings, in the necropolis of Deir el Bahari, a team of Spanish archaeologists led by Antonio Morales is studying the ingenious ways in which ancient builders protected their creations from possible plunder. Not far from the tomb of the great ruler Ili, a team of archaeologists has excavated a burial chamber and is examining a rare find of 56 vessels containing embalming materials. What was left of the robbers and early explorers turned out to be one of the greatest treasures of modern times, as the discovery sheds light on the mysteries of the mummification ritual. The fight against tomb robbers continues today. In Cairo, Dr. Shabaan of the Ministry of Culture is working with the US Department of Homeland Security to investigate three ancient mummy fragments being offered for sale on the black market in New York. Will Dr. Shabaan be able to return these remains to their homeland of Egypt? Dir.: Gwyn Williams, Mat Stimpson, Andy Bailey. Cast: Julian Barratt, Alejandro Jimenez-Serrano, John Ward, Colleen Darnell, John Darnell, Maria Nilsson, Chris Nonton, Salima Ikram, Aliaa Ismail, Iwona Kozieradzka-Ogunmakin. Led by: Julian Barratt, Rick Robles. UK, 2019

programme.desc: 2017 г. Год: 2017. Страна: Kanada. Год: 2017. S1, Ep4 «Australia's Hidden Islands»…Just to the south of the Great Barrier Reef and the Tropic of Capricorn, Fraser Island lies like a sprawling lizard. Some 120 kilometers long and up to 25 kilometers wide, Fraser Island is now the largest sand island on Earth. Somehow on this nutrient poor bed of sand life has thrived. Dingoes patrol its forests in search of wallabies while white-bellied sea eagles scour the beaches from above. From the lakes to the forests and its crystal clear streams – Fraser Island is a unique mosaic of unlikely habitats that have earned it World Heritage Status | With its utterly unique bio-diversity of flora and fauna, there is nowhere on the planet quite like Australia. In Australia, the last green turtles join the Great Barrier Reef islands to lay their eggs, while in Antarctica thousands of emperor penguins return to their breeding grounds | Just as humans modify their behaviour to match their own calendar of rituals, animals coordinate their physiology and anticipate changes in the environment according to what their biological clocks dictate. Aiming to explain how various species handle the rhythmic natural patterns as they grow more extreme and turbulent every year, the story takes a closer look at the planet's most extraordinary seasonal events of migration, rebirth, and transformation | Director: Karina Holden

programme.title: A Wild Year on Earth: May-June – A Time Of Volatility (S1E3). Dokumentika, apie gamtą. Anglija, 2020. S1, Ep3

Over the course of a turbulent year, we witness how finely tuned creatures face the Earth's seasonal patterns. programme.title: Fire and Ice: Expedition to Mount St. Helens
programme.desc: It is located in the middle of Washington state. Mount St. Helens is a still active fire mountain with a twist. Within the crater glacier there is a previously little-explored cave system that scientists are exploring and measuring. Could microorganisms live there? Exciting.

programme.title: Expedition Europa
programme.desc: The landscape appears pristine, and the Scottish Highlands (above) are actually one of the geologically oldest regions on the continent. This is where Colin Devey begins his journey through three billion (!) years of Earth's history. The stages include the German low mountain ranges, the Azores and the seven Manpupunjor rocks in the Urals.

programme.title: Expedition Europa
programme.desc: The peregrine falcon circles elegantly over the Elbe Sandstone Mountains (above). In terms of geological history, this natural landscape is still relatively young. The striking rock formations were formed by the Elbe, which worked its way through the sedimentary rocks deposited by a primeval ocean. The Alps, on the other hand, were formed through a different geological process. High peaks such as the Matterhorn and Zugspitze were folded as a result of the collision of the African and European tectonic plates. Colin Devey also visits Vesuvius in Italy. The ruins of Pompeii bear witness to the destructive forces that lie deep underground.

programme.title: Predators – hunters in danger
programme.desc: In the plains of Africa's Serengeti, the cheetah duo Luka and Kovu are faced with enormous challenges. A persistent drought forces the two predators to find a new home. (Station info).

programme.title: Predators – hunters in danger
programme.desc: For Hudson Bay's polar bears, adaptability is the key to survival. While a frozen bay offers plentiful prey in winter, ingenuity is required in the summer months. (Station info).

programme.title: Predators – hunters in danger
programme.desc: In the unforgiving Okavango Delta, lioness Nikki has no time to mourn after the loss of her baby cub. Because their pack is in the middle of a territorial war with enemy members of their own species. (Station info).

programme.title: Predators – hunters in danger
programme.desc: In the breathtaking mountains of Patagonia, a single mother cougar tries to prepare her young for survival in the wild. Time is of the essence because enemies are waiting at every corner. (Station info).

programme.title: Predators – hunters in danger
programme.desc: Wild dog Violet gives birth to six puppies in northern Zimbabwe. However, she is young and inexperienced; many of her previous litters did not survive. Did the mother learn from her mistakes? (Station info).

programme.title: Haie – mit Steve Backshall
programme.desc: Steve studies a variety of sharks adapted to life in the Atlantic. He begins his journey in the Bahamas. There he meets hammerhead sharks, which prefer to hunt stingrays. (Station info).

programme.title: Haie – mit Steve Backshall
programme.desc: In the Indian Ocean, sharks are threatened by climate change, pollution and overfishing. Steve wants to find out if these perfect predators can adapt to the changes. (Station info).

programme.title: Haie – mit Steve Backshall
programme.desc: In search of shark hotspots in the Pacific, Steve visits the island of Cocos off the coast of Costa Rica. It is the top of a huge underwater volcano. But what attracts the sharks here? (Station info).

programme.title: Into the Blue – Indonesiens Unterwasserparadiese
programme.desc: On Komodo, huge monitor lizards meet a fascinating underwater world. Manta rays, colorful fish and camouflaged ghost pipefish characterize the unique local protected area. (Station info).

programme.title: Into the Blue – Indonesiens Unterwasserparadiese
programme.desc: The journey takes you to the volcanic island of Flores and the species-rich Banda Sea in Indonesia. Active volcanoes and diverse coral reefs characterize this unique – and now threatened – ecosystem. (Station info).

programme.title: The King of the Hippos
programme.desc: It is one of the largest land mammals, the hippopotamus. The documentary follows a bull from birth. What made him king among the largest population of hippos in the Luangwa Valley? (Station info).

programme.title: Predators of the Carpathians
programme.desc: Winter in the Carpathians challenges the bears. Only half of all boys survive their first year of life. Which strategies ensure their survival? (Station info).

programme.title: The Moon – Mysterious Power of Nature
programme.desc: Fight for survival at night: During the full moon, many prey animals are in particular danger because some predators specialize in hunting in the moonlight. (Station info).

programme.title: My journey with the elephants
programme.desc: Levison Wood and his tracker fight their way 180 kilometers through the Okavango Delta. On their way they encounter elephants, predators and hippos in a species-rich swamp landscape. (Station info).

programme.title: The Hungry Games: Contest of brown bears
programme.desc: July is high season for bears in Alaska: the rivers are full to bursting with their favorite food, salmon. Using a clever technique, the bears let it land directly in their mouths. (Station info).

programme.title: Forest as a bearer of hope – can trees save the climate

programme.title: Nature's prodigies
programme.desc: Roxy is desperate. Elephant Moyo struggles with his traumatic experiences after birth - without a mother or food. Meanwhile, Robin lovingly cares for an orphaned anteater. (Station info).

programme.title: Nature's prodigies
programme.desc: Sam devotedly takes care of monsters. Now the orphaned three-toed sloth has to return to the jungle. Meanwhile, Lucy Cooke looks at a lion conservation program in Zimbabwe. (Station info).

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST MYSTERIES S5 EP12

programme.title: CỤC ĐIỀU TRA TỘI PHẠM HẢI QUÂN: KHỞI NGUỒN (PHẦN 2) - NCIS: ORIGINS (SEASON 2)
programme.desc: Phần 2 của NCIS: Nguồn gốc đi sâu hơn vào đội NCIS Camp Pendleton không thể ngăn cản do huyền thoại Mike Franks lãnh đạo, cũng như sự nghiệp ban đầu của Gibbs với tư cách là một đặc vụ và tiết lộ số phận của Lala.

programme.title: ANH EM MARIO SIÊU PHÀM - THE SUPER MARIO BROS. MOVIE
programme.desc: Bộ phim Super Mario Bros. theo chân Mario và Luigi trong một cuộc phiêu lưu gió lốc qua Vương quốc Nấm, hợp nhất với dàn nhân vật quen thuộc để đánh bại Bowser.

programme.title: TÂN BINH (PHẦN 8) - THE ROOKIE (SEASON 8)
programme.desc: John Nolan, tân binh lớn tuổi nhất của LAPD, sắp kết thúc khóa huấn luyện và phải đối mặt với bài kiểm tra khó khăn nhất từ ​​trước đến nay, cân nhắc những lựa chọn được đưa ra để theo đuổi sự thật.

programme.title: BÁC SĨ (PHẦN 2) - DOC (SEASON 2)
programme.desc: Cú sốc ập đến khi Amy và Jake chữa trị cho một nạn nhân bị cướp đang mang thai. Michael phải đối mặt với liệu pháp trị liệu cùng Katie, trong khi TJ và Sonya giải quyết bệnh tật và chuyện tình cảm.

programme.title: NHANH VÀ NGUY HIỂM PHẦN 10 - FAST X
programme.desc: Một mối đe dọa đáng sợ (Jason Momoa) xuất hiện từ quá khứ và quyết tâm tiêu diệt mọi thứ cũng như mọi người mà Dom (Vin Diesel) yêu quý trong nhiệm vụ nguy hiểm nhất từ ​​trước đến nay của gia đình.

programme.title: KHÔNG NHÌN THẤY - SIGHT UNSEEN (SEASON 2)

programme.title: THIẾU NIÊN DIỆP VẤN: THỜI KHẮC NGUY HIỂM - YOUNG IP MAN: CRISIS TIME
programme.desc: Lấy bối cảnh năm 1917, chàng trai trẻ Diệp Vấn theo đuổi việc học ở Hồng Kông. Ngôi trường bị bắt làm con tin vào ngày diễn ra cuộc thi hùng biện tiếng Anh, và khi Diệp Vấn quyết định đứng lên chống lại cuộc khủng hoảng, người ta tiết lộ rằng chủ nhân và người bạn thời thơ ấu của anh đứng đằng sau tất cả những điều này. Liệu anh ta có thể hạ gục họ và bảo vệ công lý?

programme.title: BIỆT ĐỘI BÔNG HỒNG THÉP - IRON SQUAD W
programme.desc: Mùa thứ tư của chương trình sinh tồn quân sự Hàn Quốc này sẽ quyết định nữ quân nhân ưu tú nhất. Nó tập hợp sáu đơn vị Lực lượng Đặc biệt để cạnh tranh trong các nhiệm vụ đầy thử thách trên bộ, trên biển và trên không. Những nữ quân nhân dự bị hàng đầu thành lập các đội gồm bốn người để thi đấu với nhau. Chứng kiến ​​cách họ chiến đấu đến cùng trước sáu người dẫn chương trình nổi tiếng!

programme.title: CÚ ĐẤM NGHĨA TÌNH - LOVE PUNCH
programme.desc: Võ sĩ tài năng Jia Yang bị vướng vào một cuộc chiến ngầm để trả nợ cho cha cô. Cô đánh mất khát vọng Olympic và biến mất khỏi thế giới quyền anh. 10 năm sau, huấn luyện viên Li Yue quyết tâm giúp cô thực hiện tâm nguyện của cha mình bằng cách trở lại sàn đấu. Khi niềm đam mê và nghĩa vụ va chạm, liệu Jia Yang có thể vực dậy giấc mơ quyền anh bị bỏ rơi của mình không?

programme.title: CUỘC CHIẾN TÀN KHỐC - CRUEL WAR
programme.desc: Để chống lại hiệu ứng nhà kính, nhà khoa học Yan Xin cố gắng trồng những hạt giống siêu cao su mới được phát triển trên một hòn đảo xa xôi với hy vọng biến nó thành một vùng đất mới thịnh vượng. Chồng cũ của Yan Xin quyết định đồng hành cùng cô trên hành trình đầy nguy hiểm này. Khi xung đột nảy sinh, họ chạm trán với băng đảng ma túy địa phương và một trận chiến sinh tử sắp bắt đầu.

programme.title: THỬ THÁCH TỘT ĐỘ - EXTREME ENDS
programme.desc: Extreme Ends là một chương trình thực tế phiêu lưu hành động có sự góp mặt của bốn nhân vật nổi tiếng và những vị khách đặc biệt của họ trải nghiệm sự đa dạng của Hồng Kông! Hãy tham gia cùng các người mẫu nổi tiếng Indonesia Patricia và Chika khi họ khám phá những viên ngọc ẩn giấu và khung cảnh sôi động của thành phố, đắm mình trong sự tương phản đáng kinh ngạc và những rung cảm thời thượng.

programme.title: THANH XÀ - TIỀN DUYÊN - THE FATE OF REUNION
programme.desc: Hàng ngàn năm trước, Green Snake đã được giác ngộ dưới sự hướng dẫn của Dao Qing và dần dần yêu anh ta. Tuy nhiên, sự tận tâm của cô dành cho Dao Qing đã khiến anh tái sinh và trải qua nỗi đau của cái chết. Kể từ đó, cô bắt đầu tìm kiếm những tái sinh của Đạo Thanh trong hàng trăm năm để giúp anh đảo ngược tình thế…
